t: What he said to a mother pressing her son's throat
a: عَلاَمَ تَدْغَرْنَ أَوْلاَدَكُنَّ بِهَذَا الْعِلاَقِ عَلَيْكُمْ بِهَذَا الْعُودِ الْهِنْدِيِّ فَإِنَّ فِيهِ سَبْعَةَ أَشْفِيَةٍ
p: ʿAlāma tadgharna awlādakunna bi-hādha-l-ʿilāq. ʿAlaykum bi-hādha-l-ʿūdi-l-hindiyyi fa-inna fīhi sabʿata ashfiyah
m: Why do you press on your children like this? Use this Indian aloeswood. There are seven cures in it.
